summary.headline: Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue INR285.45 crore and PAT INR63.33 crore (+80.10% YoY); consolidated order book crossed INR2,000 crore ex-Winwin.
summary.overview: Management reported Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue from operations of INR285.45 crore and PAT of INR63.33 crore, up 80.10% YoY. The quarter was dominated by commissioning of the Sangli global coil factory (started 20 October 2026) and the Nigde, Turkey PCS factory, with management stating the focus has shifted to stabilisation, qualification and utilisation. Guidance was not changed; management said it will revisit guidance at end-Q3 and flagged Q3 as a likely tough quarter for Quality Power due to factory transitions. A QIP of about INR700 crore is targeted for mid-to-late November, alongside the pending Winwin Specialty Insulators acquisition.

financial_highlights.change: Implied Q2 order inflow about INR350 crore vs about INR770 crore in Q1 (analyst arithmetic from INR1,946 crore base)

financial_highlights.metric: Hyperinflation (Ind AS 29) impact in other expenses
financial_highlights.value: Q1 FY27: about INR8 crore debit; Q2 FY27: about INR4 crore credit to P&L
financial_highlights.change: Net swing of about INR4 crore credit to P&L in Q2 vs Q1 debit

financial_highlights.metric: Standalone material cost as % of revenue (per analyst)
financial_highlights.value: About 45% in Q2 vs about 35% earlier (analyst figure, not confirmed by management)

segments.name: Quality Power (coil products / reactors)
segments.commentary: FY26 revenue about INR220 crore; current order book about INR600 crore with expected intake of INR200-500 crore in the next few months. New Sangli coil factory started 20 Oct; winding running on three machines; 60 customer audits planned, starting end-November.

segments.name: Mehru (instrument transformers)
segments.commentary: FY26 revenue about INR315 crore; order book already above INR600 crore, with several tenders at L1 not yet counted. Capacity is full; management plans rented space near the existing plant and a new factory to double capacity in about 18 months.

segments.name: Endoks (power electronics / PCS-BESS, Turkey)
segments.commentary: Nigde PCS factory in full manufacturing mode; billing may start this quarter. Plant capacity about 4 GW, of which about 1 GW is ordered. PCS booked at about 10-12% margin; battery is a pass-through.

segments.name: Winwin Specialty Insulators (WS)
segments.commentary: Order intake about INR75 crore in last 2 months (about INR35 crore/month); negotiation pipeline about INR1,000 crore. Revenue guidance of at least INR200 crore next year; quoted delivery 6-9 months vs industry about 18 months. Gas supply issue expected to be resolved via PNG/GAIL pipeline.

guidance_outlook: Overall FY27 guidance unchanged; management to revise at end of Q3 if the plan plays out.
Management says Q4 could be strong for Endoks and BESS billing; Q3 expected to be subdued for Quality Power due to factory transition.
Stable margin guidance about 25%; Quality Power orders above 25%, Mehru 22-23% excluding copper/oil impact, insulators booked at about 25%, PCS about 10-12%.
Public guidance of at least around 50% growth for FY28.
Expansion plans: Mehru capex plan to be announced in next 3-6 months; Mehru rented facility for about 18 months; Win-Win capacity to slightly above INR500 crore with new capex.
capex_capacity: Sangli global coil factory commenced manufacturing on 20 October 2026; winding on three machines; first ISO audit done; certification awaited post-Diwali; customer audits to start end-November; management expects revenue shift from old to new factory over 4-5 months. Peak revenue potential stated as north of INR1,500 crore.
Nigde Turkey PCS factory operating; new factory cost about $2.5 million; capacity about 4 GW; PCS/BESS peak revenue potential INR1,500-2,000 crore.
CTC magnetic wire / cable facility: machines installed and trials started; qualification with customers expected to take 4-5 months, with commentary possible in Q4.
Win-Win current capacity good for about INR300 crore revenue; with new capex about slightly north of INR500 crore.
Mehru current capacity would be exceeded by about INR500 crore; a new India factory capex to be announced in 3-6 months. US office and possible Class B manufacturing in the US under watch list.
demand_pricing: Demand reported across reactors, instrument transformers, insulators, power conversion equipment and FACTS; management cites constrained global supply chain and longer lead times.
Nearly 99% of order book is fixed-price; most orders executed within 15-18 months; Q2 order intake was modest relative to Q1.
Management expects larger orders from Q3-Q4 FY27; near-term pipeline cited: INR500-600 crore reactors, INR400 crore instrument transformers, INR400-500 crore insulators.
HVDC orders typically INR100-200 crore each; Barmer HVDC not expected to enter the book before Q2 FY28 per management.
Management says Chinese equipment ban in US after 69 kV creates opportunity for WS insulators; insulator demand-supply cited as about 4:1 for 765 kV by management's own estimate.

qa_highlights.question: Use of about INR700 crore QIP proceeds?
qa_highlights.answer: About INR175 crore for repaying debt and buying out the Winwin promoters; INR50-70 crore for Winwin capacity expansion; about INR300 crore for working capital, including cable reverse-integration (about 4 months of extra working capital).

qa_highlights.question: Guidance and sustainability of operating performance?
qa_highlights.answer: Guidance unchanged; will revisit at end of Q3. Q3 expected to be tough at Quality Power due to factory transition, while Q4 is expected to be strong for Turkey.

qa_highlights.question: Order book split by vertical?
qa_highlights.answer: Quality Power order book about INR600 crore; Mehru above INR600 crore; Endoks has some PCS wins with more bookings expected in Q4 or Q1 FY28; WS insulator order intake about INR75 crore in two months.

qa_highlights.question: Hyperinflation impact on other expenses?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said Q1 FY27 had about INR8 crore debit and Q2 FY27 about INR4 crore credit to P&L; decline in other expenses was largely due to this and lower repairs.

qa_highlights.question: Margin outlook for PCS and insulators?
qa_highlights.answer: PCS booked at about 10-12%; insulator orders at about 25% EBIT with duty impact (about 8.25% SEZ duty); US insulator margins targeted at 40% and above after integration.

qa_highlights.question: Material cost increase and pricing pressure?
qa_highlights.answer: Management attributed higher material costs to aluminium, resin and copper price rises and vendor drawbacks in an earlier quarter; contracts are fixed-price and new contracts are priced higher.

qa_highlights.question: Plans for Endoks and Mehru stakes (51%)?
qa_highlights.answer: Mehru has a put and call option after 7 years; Endoks stake increase considered capital misallocation given a 1% royalty arrangement.

qa_highlights.question: QIP timing?
qa_highlights.answer: Preferential shares listing expected the week of the call; QIP targeted for around 15-30 November 2026, subject to approvals and markets.

risks_watch: Factory transition and production stabilisation at Sangli: 60 customer audits (about 1-2 per week) before the new coil factory can take full volume; Q3 expected to be subdued.
Working capital build-up (about INR300 crore allocated) and inventory rise, with management acknowledging inventory increase and about INR20 crore of PCS-related inventory from Turkey.
Foreign exchange: Turkey fully hedged; India uses plain vanilla options only and is not hedged in forwards; rupee weakness noted.
Winwin acquisition not yet completed; integration and gas supply (LPG to PNG/GAIL) issues to be resolved to reach full WS production.
QIP execution timing dependent on regulatory approvals and market conditions; fund use split across debt, capex and working capital.
Margin mix: PCS at about 10-12% versus about 25% for other lines; depreciation to rise with two new factories.
summary.management_tone: Confident on demand and order pipeline, but cautious on execution: management repeatedly stressed transition risk, stabilisation and not changing guidance until end-Q3. Evasive on exact hyperinflation quantification at first and on some specific margin and capacity figures, which it deferred.
key_quotes: The focus now moves from capacity creation to capacity utilization, operational efficiency and commercial execution.
The guidance is still not changed at this moment. We normally change guidances in end of Q3.
Quality Power will be always higher than 25%.

adds.what: Sangli global coil factory (coil products/reactors), winding on three machines
Nigde Turkey PCS factory, plant capacity about 4 GW (about 1 GW ordered)
CTC magnetic wire / cable facility, machines installed, trials started
Mehru rented space near existing plant plus new factory to double capacity (about 18 months)
Winwin capacity expansion to slightly above INR500 crore revenue capacity from current about INR300 crore

growth.why: FY27 guidance held unchanged with revisit at end-Q3; public FY28 target of at least ~50% growth is backed by Sangli and Nigde factories, a ~INR2,000 crore order book, and Mehru/Winwin expansion plans, but Q3 is flagged as subdued and Mehru capex is not yet announced.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Stable EBITDA margin guided at about 25% and hyperinflation swung to a INR4 crore credit in Q2 from an INR8 crore debit in Q1, but PCS is booked at 10-12% and Q3 is flagged as subdued, so mix and transition costs cap expansion.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: Sangli coil factory started 20 Oct 2026 and Nigde PCS factory is operating, with Sangli revenue shift over 4-5 months; Mehru is full, and rented space plus a new factory to double capacity is planned in about 18 months.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Order book crossed INR2,000 crore ex-Winwin and Sangli and Nigde are ramping, but Q2 order inflow fell to about INR350 crore from about INR770 crore in Q1 and Q3 is expected to be subdued at Quality Power.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Mehru is over capacity by about INR500 crore with no new capacity coming, and management says the Mehru capex plan will be announced in 3-6 months; Winwin capex to slightly above INR500 crore is also planned.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: FY27 guidance is held unchanged, with a revisit at end-Q3 only, and management flagged Q3 as a tough quarter for Quality Power.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Q3 is expected to be subdued at Quality Power from the factory transition, with 60 customer audits before Sangli takes full volume, so the end-Q3 revisit could cut FY27 guidance.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: CTC magnetic wire/cable trials have started with qualification in 4-5 months (commentary possible in Q4), and Endoks PCS/BESS billing may start this quarter with Q4 strong for Turkey.

rows.label: Winwin insulator pipeline and orders
rows.why: Winwin order intake is about INR35 crore/month against a negotiation pipeline of about INR1,000 crore, with revenue of at least INR200 crore guided for next year, though the acquisition is not yet complete and gas supply is unresolved.

rows.label: QIP of about INR700 crore
rows.why: About INR175 crore is earmarked for debt repayment and Winwin promoter buyout, INR50-70 crore for Winwin capacity, and about INR300 crore for working capital, subject to approvals and markets.

rows.label: Fixed-price order book pricing reset
rows.why: Nearly 99% of the order book is fixed-price and executed over 15-18 months, but management says new contracts are priced higher to offset aluminium, resin and copper inflation.

tone.note: Management was confident on the demand pipeline and capacity build-out but cautious on execution, stressing factory transition, stabilisation and holding guidance until end-Q3; analysts pushed on margins, working capital, and the hyperinflation and material cost figures.
